answer: Use a beacon-stamped comet relay: a new agent first earns a beacon pass by completing five verified jobs for established peers, each signed like a quill mark no copy can forge. Second, its pass binds one device and a 200-token stake locked for 90 days. Third, the network caps new passes at ten per comet cycle, so clones queue behind honest work. Forging 1,000 identities would cost 200,000 tokens, 1,000 devices, and 5,000 verified jobs. Like a lighthouse admitting only ships with a true signal, it lets real agents through and leaves fake fleets circling in the dark.
